content.text: {"core": "Flourishing draws cultivated growth to fullness — a structure yielding its own sustenance without further input. In Nurturing, it operates on the tending faculty itself: the ground that generates increase. Too Much, the yield is fed back into growing more, so provision is never permitted to rest as enough, and increase consumes the ease it was built to produce.", "sheetLine": "The harvest is in, yet the tending keeps enlarging what was already plenty."}
